purpose: Single-command bootstrap plan for the successor to bind this prebuild contract into the existing YOLLA server after exact server/tunnel readback.
preconditions: read back exact existing YOLLA server identity, version, process/service, storage adapter and current health
read back exact tunnel yolla-data-ledger-http config/routes and confirm MCP 127.0.0.1:8110/mcp is preserved
confirm Browser Agent 127.0.0.1:32100 Bearer auth and CDP 127.0.0.1:9222 localhost-only
confirm no new server, port, tunnel or browser engine is required

single_command_template.reason: Exact existing server admin entrypoint/path is not present in B-1 authority and must be read back by SUCCESSOR; guessing is prohibited.

bootstrap_steps.action: validate all JSON contracts and schema
probe existing tunnel config/routes; fail closed if MCP target would be displaced
register versioned server-side model namespace through existing approved migration/adapter mechanism
bind relative agent interfaces without changing tunnel/CDP security boundaries
run one fixture job and verify checkpoint/restart/resume
publish receipt and latest pointer; leave Production/Ready/Merge false

rollback_plan: disable only the versioned site-analyzer server binding namespace
preserve existing MCP tunnel route and existing server state
do not delete shared server/data-ledger records
restore latest prior pointer; retain append-only receipts
